scope: Rust-only local authority memory-policy receipt; no protocol/coordinator/retry policy changes
claims: Receipt requires a positive exact captured grant, strict sampled ceiling breach, no earlier selected authority stop, live-child probe and a completed kill procedure.
First selected stop owns authority cause while later termination requests still execute; legacy kill behavior remains unchanged.
Private receipt captures charged vector, checked ceiling and observed KiB before namespace closure, drain and upload.
Real namespace R/2R cases for SHA-256 and BLAKE3 preserve stdout/stderr/output bytes and original request.
Actual upload failure leaves receipt available and no finished result.
Actual external SIGKILL near the ceiling qualifies existing heuristic telemetry with enforced=false and produces no receipt.
limitations: Receipt does not prove exclusive physical exit cause, hard memory isolation, namespace closure, directory cleanup, upload success or authoritative acceptance.
Ordering, exited/error probes and kill-result failures use deterministic private decision seams; exhaustive OS scheduling and OS kill-error injection are not claimed.
Protocol still uses the existing Complete path; no wire receipt, coordinator MemoryFailure classification or M6 retention change.
Initial fixture self-SIGKILL was ignored by namespace PID1 and failed its oracle; it was corrected to supervisor SIGKILL with real launch PID. Initial failure remains in focused-tests.log.
Bazel integration is performed separately by parent; this isolated receipt qualification uses Cargo with repository lints.
